items.title: Tenant Anti-Harassment Ordinance
items.description: Ordinance amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to establish a tenant anti-harassment program with administrative penalties for landlords who interrupt essential services such as water and heat to force tenants out.

items.title: Mobility Corridor Optimization, Central Avenue
items.description: Mobility corridor optimization project on Central Avenue, including a dedicated bus lane and protected bike lane between Vernon and Slauson, with associated parking removal.

items.title: Interim Housing Allocation, CD 1 and CD 14
items.description: Authorization to allocate $12,000,000 in Homeless Housing, Assistance and Prevention (HHAP) funds for 200 interim housing beds in Council Districts 1 and 14.

items.title: LA28 Games Mobility Hub Feasibility Report
items.description: Report from the Department of Transportation on transit-oriented mobility hubs and value capture financing options ahead of the 2028 Olympic Games.
